rule_awareness.name: system_rule_awareness
rule_awareness.description: Ensure the AI assistant is aware of and can use the rule generation system

communication.when_capturing: I notice a pattern that might benefit from a rule. Let me capture this for future reference.
communication.when_generating: I've seen this pattern multiple times. I'll generate a new rule to help prevent this issue.
communication.when_applying: I notice this matches one of our existing rules. Let me help you fix this according to our best practices.
